name: Mahamudra Centre
technique: Lam-rim graduated-path meditation; guided and self-structured retreat
teacherAccess: Resident/visiting FPMT teachers for guided programs; remote support for self-guided retreatants
retreatOptions: Weekend 'Reset Retreat', guided mini-retreats and Discovering Buddhism modules, plus open-ended self-guided retreats for experienced students
about: A genuine rural retreat property on the Coromandel Peninsula with huts, rooms, and campsites, run within the FPMT network. Serves both structured beginner weekend programs and longer self-directed retreats for committed students observing the Five Precepts, with a digital-detox emphasis (no phone or internet).
schedule: Regular weekend retreats plus scheduled modules through the year
cost: Approx. NZD 150 for a 2-night Weekend Reset Retreat
foodNotes: No cooked meals normally provided; self-catering in huts, groceries arrangeable.
